AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) focuses on AI answers. GEO (Geographic Search Engine Optimization) strengthens local and regional findability in Maps, local packs and location-based search. SEO optimizes for classic search engines. Read more: ⟦L0⟧How AEO, GEO and SEO are related⟦/L0⟧ · ⟦L1⟧What is AEO?⟦/L1⟧.
